focus: tests: 131 KEEP-PASS v1 tests, how v2 runs them, E2E GP1-GP11 coverage of every B item, keyless harness

findings.claim: The release gate does not run the 131 KEEP-PASS v1 unit tests at all, so a release can ship with a broken KEEP-PASS test even though ADR-0003 r2 says this must not happen.
findings.evidence: ADR-0003 r2 text (docs/v2/adr/0003-e2e-only-golden-tests.md, 'v2.0 exit gate') states: '/release runs layer 1 (vitest on the KEEP-PASS list) and layer 2 before it runs layer 3, and stops on the first failure in any layer.' But .claude/skills/release/SKILL.md step 2 only runs: 'npm ci && npm run build && node --test e2e/cases' — this is layer 2 (E2E golden, node:test) only. There is no vitest / KEEP-PASS invocation anywhere in SKILL.md. This exact gap was already flagged in r2 QA (docs/v2/review/TEST-TRIAGE-r2.md, 'Major: /release skill only runs node --test e2e/cases; it never runs the kept v1 tests') and is still unfixed in the current doc set.
findings.fix: Add a vitest step for the KEEP-PASS list (TEST-TRIAGE-r2.md) in SKILL.md step 2, before the E2E golden run, and stop on first failure there as ADR-0003 r2 requires.
findings.note_on_prior: r2 flagged the missing step; not fixed since, so re-reported with a fresh evidence quote from the current file.

findings.claim: TECH-SPEC still names a single test runner (node:test) for everything, with no mention that the 131 KEEP-PASS tests run on vitest+TS. Two runners must both be wired into CI, but only one is documented.
findings.evidence: docs/v2/TECH-SPEC.md:263 'Proposed test runner: node:test. The tests run against built .mjs files, so no transform step is needed (Q9).' and :416 'Q9 | Test runner = node:test; matrix 3 OS x min/current Node, <=10 min per OS | [D]'. TEST-TRIAGE-r2.md says the 131 KEEP-PASS files 'stays as-is' and run on vitest+TS (v1 runner), confirmed by `grep describe/it/vitest` usage in cm-main test files (e.g. tests/server-stdin-eof-exit.test.ts uses `import { describe, it, expect, beforeEach, afterEach, vi } from 'vitest'`). TECH-SPEC never states vitest stays in CI.
findings.fix: Edit TECH-SPEC §6/§10 Q9 to name two runners explicitly: vitest for layer-1 KEEP-PASS files, node:test for layer-2 E2E golden; state both run in CI and in /release.
findings.note_on_prior: Same gap flagged in r2 QA; still present verbatim in current TECH-SPEC.

findings.claim: GP9 (Lifecycle) in TECH-SPEC only lists 'stdin EOF, parent kill, on 3 OS' with no TTY-gate case. The v1 test it would retire, tests/server-stdin-eof-exit.test.ts, pins a TTY/non-TTY branch that GP9 does not cover, so retiring that file would silently drop a fix for issue #534 and its #236 regression guard.
findings.archaeology: ARCHAEOLOGY: INTRODUCED_BY d56a9fc0 ('test(lifecycle): pin stdin EOF recheck contract behind #534 (closes #534 partial - 3 of 4)', Tue May 12 2026, repo cm-main). ORIGINAL_INTENT (commit message, quoted): "The 'end' listener wired in lifecycle.ts (added in #388 / 259077c) is load-bearing for the #534 fix: combined with the bridge-child fast poll (slice 2), it collapses the orphan-detection window to ~0 when the Pi parent dies abruptly without sending SIGTERM... Tests cover: 'end' listener registered when stdin is not a TTY, NOT registered when stdin is a TTY (OpenCode ts-plugin path), emitting 'end' with a dead parent triggers shutdown immediately, emitting 'end' with a live parent stays a no-op (#236 regression guard)." Confirmed in the test file header (tests/server-stdin-eof-exit.test.ts, cm-main) which says the mechanism deliberately does NOT call process.exit(0) unconditionally, because #236 proved that causes spurious -32000 errors on transient pipe events. REGRESSION_RISK: GP9 as written in TECH-SPEC (docs/v2/TECH-SPEC.md:297, 'GP9 | Lifecycle | stdin EOF, parent kill, on 3 OS | exit < 2s; no spawn at boot; no chdir | #1100 #982 #953 #1167 #923 #924 #974') checks only end-to-end exit behaviour and never the TTY-vs-non-TTY listener-registration branch, nor the live-parent no-op branch. A v2 refactor of lifecycle.ts that re-registers the 'end' listener unconditionally (including on a TTY, e.g. the OpenCode ts-plugin path) would pass GP9 as specced today while re-breaking #534/#236. SAFE_FIX_CONSTRAINTS: GP9's case list must explicitly include (a) listener registered only when stdin is not a TTY, (b) 'end' with dead parent -> shutdown, (c) 'end' with live parent -> no-op, matching the four pinned assertions in tests/server-stdin-eof-exit.test.ts before that file is retired.
findings.fix: Add the TTY-gate and live-parent-no-op assertions to GP9's case list in TECH-SPEC §6, citing #534 and #236, before tests/server-stdin-eof-exit.test.ts is allowed a REMOVED verdict in the test ledger.
findings.note_on_prior: r2 QA flagged this same gap ('GP9 only checks stdin-EOF exit, not the TTY gate...') as a regression-risk; still unaddressed in current TECH-SPEC. This finding adds the full git archaeology chain the r2 note lacked.

findings.claim: ADR-0012's keyless harness case list (routing, deny/repeat-allow, compaction, hook firing) still does not name the ADR-0016 LV8-LV10 subagent-large-output cases or the ADR-0008 LV1-LV2 cases, even though ADR-0017 extends ADR-0012 and ADR-0003 r2's layer-3 definition requires them.
findings.evidence: docs/v2/adr/0012-keyless-live-harness.md 'Cases' section lists only: routing, deny/repeat-allow, compaction, hook firing (G25). docs/v2/adr/0003-e2e-only-golden-tests.md r2 text requires: '3. Live checks (ADR-0012 harness), including the subagent large-output cases (ADR-0016 LV8-LV10) and the updated-I/O cases (ADR-0008 LV1-LV2).' No LV8-LV10 or LV1-LV2 term appears anywhere in ADR-0012 or ADR-0017.
findings.fix: Add LV8-LV10 and LV1-LV2 as named cases in ADR-0012's (or ADR-0017's) case list so the keyless harness actually runs the MUST-level ADR-0016 large-output checks live.
findings.note_on_prior: Repeats the substance of an r2 QA finding; re-verified against the current ADR-0012/0017 text, where it is still true.
